lines.zh: 我压低身子，从灌木后面走。
lines.en: I keep low and move behind the brush.
My bow hangs across my back.

lines.zh: 我沿着村子的外围绕着。
lines.en: I circle the outside of the village.

lines.zh: 我踩过的地方没有声音。
lines.en: My steps make no sound.
I am short and quick on my feet.
I skip the gate and take the side path.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边看树上的痕迹。
lines.en: I read the marks on the trees as I go.
My boots are stitched hide.
I stop and listen.
I head toward the firelight.

lines.zh: 我跟在一队哥布林后面。
lines.en: I follow behind a goblin band.

lines.zh: 我往林子里退，再换个方向。
lines.en: I slip into the trees and come out elsewhere.
I hitch my quiver higher.
I wait for the ones ahead to move off.
I creep forward another stretch.
I crouch by the tree roots.
I count my arrows.
I am checking the wind.
I slowly string my bow.
I chew a strip of tough meat.
I tilt my head toward the distance.
My ear tips twitch.
I wait for game to come to me.

lines.zh: 我把箭尾在指间转了转。
lines.en: I twirl an arrow between my fingers.
My shadow hides in the grass.

lines.zh: 我蹲在树根边，只数我的箭。
lines.en: I crouch by the roots and count my arrows.
I ease back into the shade.
I am sharpening an arrowhead.
I glance up into the tree.
I lay the bow across my knees.

lines.zh: 我等了很久，弓弦都松了。
lines.en: I have waited long; my bowstring slackened.
You are much taller than a goblin.
I slowly put a hand to my bow.
You are not from our village.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，算你值几支箭。
lines.en: Head tilted, I count how many arrows you're worth.
I am guessing which way you will go.
You wear no disguise.

lines.zh: 我把弓弦弹了一下，听它还紧不紧。
lines.en: I pluck the string to hear if it's still tight.
You had better back off.

lines.zh: 我们村里没见过你这样的人。
lines.en: We have not seen your kind in the village.

lines.zh: 我把弓从背上取下，搭上了箭。
lines.en: I take the bow off my back and nock an arrow.
I yelp.
I give half a step with the bow still up.
I grit my teeth.

lines.zh: 血从我的手臂上流下来。
lines.en: Blood runs down my arm.
My quiver hits the ground.
I nock an arrow while retreating.
This pain is nothing.
I bare my teeth at you.
What is that in your hands?
Goblins trust only gold.
Bring gold and we can talk.
My bow came from a village raid.
I sniff; it is not meat.

lines.zh: 这点东西不够换一支箭。
lines.en: That is not worth an arrow.
I look, and take it anyway.
I am not picky, but I am not stupid.
Bring something valuable next time.
I stuff it in my pouch.

lines.zh: 我的弓斜挎在背上，已经上弦。
lines.en: My bow rides my back, already strung.
That is you being sensible.
I will save it for the road.
Give me another piece.
I am small, but not soft.
My bow is knocked askew.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的靴子，兽皮都皱了。
lines.en: You step on my boot and crease the hide.
I grab your hem to steady myself.

lines.zh: 撞上你，我弹开，弓还举着。
lines.en: We collide; I bounce off, bow still up.
I bare my teeth at you.
Two of my arrows spill out.
I pick them up and glare.
I have a den in the village.
She shoots better than I do.
We watch two paths separately.
Her arrow always lands before mine.
We roasted a deer together.
We take shifts at night.
She is loud, but I do not mind.
The firelight catches her face.

lines.zh: 我们各自回到自己的树后。
lines.en: We go back to our own trees.
Dawn is coming.
I bend and pick up the arrow.
What is this worth?
I shove it into my belt pouch.
That is mine now.

lines.zh: 我把它咬了一下，是真的。
lines.en: I bite it; it is real.
I keep every arrow that falls.
I look and put it in my quiver.
Do not expect it back.
My bow is up.
You have stepped into my line.
I draw the string.
I fix on your chest.
I have waited long for this shot.
You will not stop my arrow.

lines.zh: 你从左边来，我就往左瞄。
lines.en: You come from the left, so I aim left.

lines.zh: 猎物进林子了，弓先拉开。
lines.en: Prey's in the trees. Bow's already drawn.
I change position.
I am behind the tree.

lines.zh: 第一箭偏了，第二箭不会。
lines.en: The first went wide; the second will not.
You hide behind a rock.
I wait for your head to show.
I slip to your flank.

lines.zh: 站稳点，我这一箭不便宜。
lines.en: Hold still. My arrows aren't cheap.
Run. You're easier to hit once you're tired.
My arrow strikes your shoulder.
I draw the bow full.
Up close I use the knife.
I slash your calf.
I kick your knee.
You lunge; I back off and shoot.
My arrow sticks in your shield.
You are sweating.
I draw to my ear.

lines.zh: 别追，下一箭我会瞄得更准。
lines.en: Don't follow; my next arrow flies truer.

lines.zh: 我从哥布林村的方向来。
lines.en: I came from the goblin village.
I take my stand at the forest edge.
I test the bowstring.
This land was ours first.
I crouch and read the tracks.
My quiver is full.
I wait behind a tree a while.
The village sent me out.
I smell something unfamiliar.
I pull my hood lower.

lines.zh: 兽皮袖子烧焦了，拍不掉。
lines.en: The hide sleeve is singed and will not pat out.

lines.zh: 我从树上掉下来，摔得闷响。
lines.en: I fall from the tree with a heavy thud.
I swallow water and my short legs kick wildly.
The blast throws me behind a tree.
An arrow pins my leg.

lines.zh: 一阵光，我的眼睛花了一下。
lines.en: A flash of magic and my eyes blur.
Hunger keeps me from drawing the bow.
Lightning strikes and I drop flat.

lines.zh: 我掉下去，手里还抓着弓。
lines.en: I fall, still gripping my bow.
